description: Per-question totals read by hand from the page images of question papers whose totals can't be read from the PDF: scans with no text layer, or papers whose text layer is unreadable ("text_layer": "unreadable", used only when no 'Total for Question' lines can be parsed). The totals must add up to paper_total, read from the paper itself. Each entry records where the numbers were read.
